name: Creamed Onions
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Peel one quart of medium-sized onions, place them in a saucepan, cover with boiling water; add one teaspoonful of sugar, and boil until nearly done; add one teaspoonful salt; boil a few minutes longer, then drain in a colander.
Melt two tablespoonfuls of butter, add half a tablespoonful of flour.
Stir and cook two minutes; add one cupful of hot milk and cook two minutes longer, and season with whole pepper and salt.
Put the onions in a hot dish and pour the sauce over them.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Peel one quart of medium-sized onions, place them in a saucepan, cover with boiling water; add one teaspoonful of sugar, and boil until nearly done; add one teaspoonful salt; boil a few minutes longer, then drain in a colander.
2. Melt two tablespoonfuls of butter, add half a tablespoonful of flour.
3. Stir and cook two minutes; add one cupful of hot milk and cook two minutes longer, and season with whole pepper and salt.
4. Put the onions in a hot dish and pour the sauce over them.
